name: Koibito Yuugi
source:
Yuuta has started living alone in spite of opposition from his parents. But, he sinks into poverty soon.... One day, his older brother, Shuuhei, is transferred to his town and starts living together with him. From poor life to rich life, thanks to Shuuhei. But, Yuuta forgets the fact that Shuuhei is a big worrywart....
